# Attestix

> AI agent identity and signed evidence tooling.

Attestix is an Apache 2.0 toolkit for DID-based agent identities, signed Verifiable Credentials, delegated authority, provenance and audit records. Governance workflows collect evidence and generate provider-review drafts. They do not establish SOC 2, ISO, GDPR or EU AI Act conformity or certification.

## Public source and documentation

- [Core repository](https://github.com/VibeTensor/attestix)
- [Documentation](https://attestix.io/docs)
- [Credential verifier](https://attestix.io/verify)

- [JavaScript SDK](https://github.com/VibeTensor/attestix-js)
- [Go SDK](https://github.com/VibeTensor/attestix-go)
- [Java SDK](https://github.com/VibeTensor/attestix-java)

- [Rust SDK](https://github.com/VibeTensor/attestix-rs)

## Trust and operating limits

Signatures support integrity and key association, not the truth or legal validity of a claim. Verifiers need an explicit trusted-key policy and must reject unsupported inputs. The default REST service is authenticated and single-tenant; a tenant header does not provide cross-tenant authorization.

Local erasure removes managed records and parseable local backups. Remote replicas, prior exports, shared credentials and external backups require separate handling. Erasure tooling does not establish GDPR conformity.

Evaluate the exact installed release. Source checks, registry publication and production deployment are separate acceptance steps. Review key custody, restore, authentication, monitoring and incident response before production adoption. Hosted offerings are planned; source availability does not establish hosted service readiness.

## Installation

Python: `pip install attestix`. For other languages, consult the SDK release pages and verify registry availability for the required version.

## EU AI Act

Applicability depends on the system and operator role. Consult the [official staged timeline](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/regulatory-framework-ai) and [Regulation (EU) 2026/1744](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:32026R1744). Attestix supplies evidence tooling, not a legal conformity decision.
